key.name: schema-version
key.description: Incremented when settings schema changes to trigger migration

key.name: frequency
key.description: VFO frequency in kilohertz (e.g., 144200 = 144.200 MHz)

key.name: squelch
key.description: 0-8 where 0 is most permissive, 8 is strictest

key.name: tx-power-high
key.description: When true, use high power (1W). When false, use low power (0.5W)

key.name: pre-emphasis
key.description: Enable 6dB/octave pre-emphasis on transmitted audio

key.name: de-emphasis
key.description: Enable 6dB/octave de-emphasis on received audio

key.name: high-pass-filter
key.description: Enable high-pass filter to remove low frequency noise

key.name: low-pass-filter
key.description: Enable low-pass filter to remove high frequency noise

key.name: channels
key.description: JSON array of Channel objects. Use export/import CSV for backup.

key.name: last-channel-index
key.description: -1 means VFO mode, otherwise index into channels array

key.name: mic-gain
key.description: Mic gain boost level: "none", "low", "med", or "high"

key.name: tile-source
key.description: Tile source for map: "online" (OSM) or "offline" (MBTiles)

key.name: offline-tiles-path
key.description: Path to MBTiles archive for offline map tiles

key.name: aprs-callsign
key.description: Amateur radio callsign for APRS transmissions (e.g., "KD4LCD")

key.name: aprs-ssid
key.description: Secondary station identifier for APRS (0-15)

key.name: aprs-symbol-table
key.description: APRS symbol table ID: "/" (primary) or "\\" (alternate)

key.name: aprs-symbol-code
key.description: APRS symbol code character (e.g., "'" for person, ">" for car)

key.name: aprs-comment
key.description: Optional comment to include in APRS beacon transmissions

key.name: aprs-tx-enabled
key.description: Enable APRS beacon transmission

key.name: aprs-beacon-dest
key.description: Destination callsign for APRS beacons (default: APRS)
